title: A page empty for want of a project routes to the person's agent
verification: Rendered component tests cover single-project and multi-project pages over an empty universe, the Projects page with and without rows, New item with no visible project versus no creatable project, and the zero-project harness module. Served browser proof remains a deployment obligation.
text: Every project-scoped page with no visible project, the Projects page and the zero-project harness module show: Ask Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor to add a project to Yoke. The names are generated from the harness registry. New item keeps 'Ask a project owner for access' only when projects are visible but none accept new items.
